answer: Sybil resistance holds only if identity costs more than one epoch of earnings. Condition one: registration burns a bond forfeit on duplicate detection, priced near the nectar an honest forager extracts. Condition two: peers attest through a willow-thin random quorum, so a forged key cannot self-vouch and must be woven into already-bonded agents. Two cheap clones dilute the bond pool fast enough to notice.
